tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Behind every panel: the Studio window background, the canvas surround, the graph paper of empty states.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panel bodies (layers, properties, timesheet) and the floating in-page editor.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hover fills, chips, popovers, menus, the part-card thumbnail frame. One step above surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Panel headers, the top bar, the tool rail, inputs, the timesheet ruler. Holds only ink and ink-muted text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Ruler lines between docked panels, rows and sections. Separation only, never a control's edge.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, toggles, checkboxes and secondary buttons. Holds 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on ground, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk. Also the G-pen colour of a construction's main lines.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, secondary text, inactive icons on every surface.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Construction (ruler) lines in drawings, disabled text and placeholders. Below 4.5:1 by design; never carries information a person needs.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: The one accent: selection, focus rings, the primary button, the playhead, and every G-pen mark (active tool, selected tab, the frame around a part on the page). Text-safe on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: on-cobalt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a cobalt fill (primary button, the name tag of a marked part).

tokens.name: cobalt-wash
tokens.usage: Fill behind a selected row, a pressed segment or toggle. Never behind text that relies on colour.

tokens.name: vermilion
tokens.usage: Engine protection only: the 45° hatch, the 制限中 diamond, destructive actions. Always with a word or the hatch. In Gesso it is text-safe only on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: vermilion-wash
tokens.usage: Fill behind a 制限中 notice or row.

tokens.name: lamp-amber
tokens.usage: Advice that is not enforced (読みにくいかもしれません) and atmosphere layers. Always with a word and the triangle or dotted edge.

tokens.name: ok-green
tokens.usage: 保存済み and other confirmed states, always with the word and the filled circle.

tokens.name: pen-bone
tokens.usage: G-pen colour for the compass arc and secondary main lines of a construction drawing. Never text, never a control edge.

families.ui: "BIZ UDPGothic", "Hiragino Sans", "Yu Gothic UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The cover and the first-run screen only. 84 ÷ φ ≈ 52.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Large titles: the first-run screen and the design-system pages. 52 ÷ φ ≈ 32.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: まだレイヤーがありません

styles.name: strong
styles.usage: Panel titles, section headings, the selected tab. 20 ÷ φ ≈ 13.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: ページの部品をクリックして選びます
styles.usage: Row names, button labels, field values that are words, messages.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Field labels, secondary lines, chips, hover help. Never below 12px.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase English eyebrows on panel headers. Japanese labels use small instead.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Every numeric value: positions, opacity, angles, counts. Tabular figures.

styles.name: frame
styles.usage: Frame numbers on the timesheet ruler and the コマ打ち setting; protection labels (player.controls.bottom).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: 1 × 4. Icon-to-label gap inside a chip; label-to-control gap in a field.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: 2 × 4. Gap between controls in a row; padding inside a floating panel.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: 3 × 4. Row side padding; gap between fields; panel header side padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: 5 × 4. Section side padding; gap between sections of a sheet.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: 8 × 4. Canvas margin around the live page; gap between groups of a page.

tokens.name: space-52
tokens.usage: 13 × 4. Top margin of a sheet or a first-run screen.

tokens.name: space-84
tokens.usage: 21 × 4. Top padding of an empty state, above its drawing.

tokens.name: space-136
tokens.usage: 34 × 4. The largest step: the height of a construction drawing in an empty state.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips, cards, sections drawn on a surface. Docked panels have no radius.

tokens.name: radius-float
tokens.usage: The floating in-page editor and popovers. Inside it: radius-float − space-4 = radius-control.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggle tracks only (height 20, a half-circle end).

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, tabs, icon buttons, layer rows, panel headers.

tokens.name: control-dense
tokens.usage: Timesheet tracks, chips, the toggle track, small icon buttons inside rows.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: The Studio top bar, the side-panel header and the tool rail's width.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: The Studio timesheet (84 + 52).

tokens.name: panel-layers
tokens.usage: Studio layers panel. 340 : 212 ≈ φ.

tokens.name: panel-properties
tokens.usage: Studio properties panel and the floating in-page editor.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Every ruler line: panel borders, row separators, input edges, construction lines. Uniform, never tapered.

tokens.name: pen
tokens.usage: G-pen marks at their widest: the active tool's circle, the selected tab, the frame around a part on the page.

tokens.name: pen-large
tokens.usage: G-pen main lines of a construction drawing 136px or taller, and its spiral.

tokens.name: pen-tip
tokens.usage: Width at the start (入り) and end (抜き) of a G-pen line.

tokens.name: overshoot
tokens.usage: How far a G-pen frame's sides run past each corner.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The floating in-page editor and popovers only. Docked panels never cast shadows.
